banner.imageAlt: Person browsing PrettyFull's frequently asked questions
banner.title: Frequently Asked Questions
banner.subtitle: All the answers about your orders, shipping and our products.

item1.title: PRE-ORDER / BULK PURCHASE ITEMS
item1.description: Some products are temporarily out of stock and offered as pre-orders while we restock. Once a pre-order is confirmed, it cannot be cancelled. See our Terms of Sale for the full policy. Please check your parcel as soon as you receive it and contact us immediately if a product is defective, damaged, or doesn't match your order, so we can resolve the situation quickly.

item2.title: HOW DO I TRACK MY ORDER?
item2.description: As soon as your order ships, you receive an email with a tracking link. You can also find this link at any time in the "My Orders" section of your account.

item3.title: CAN I CHANGE OR CANCEL MY ORDER?
item3.description: Contact us as soon as possible after placing your order. As long as it hasn't been prepared for shipping yet, we can update the address, size, or cancel the order.

item4.title: WHAT ARE THE DELIVERY TIMES?
item4.description: Orders ship within 2 to 5 business days. Allow a further 2 to 4 business days for standard delivery in mainland France, and 5 to 10 business days for international deliveries.

item5.title: DO YOU DELIVER INTERNATIONALLY?
item5.description: Yes, we deliver to most European countries as well as North America. Any customs fees remain the recipient's responsibility according to local regulations.

item6.title: ITEMS IN STOCK
item6.description: Returns, exchanges or partial replacements (at our discretion after reviewing the issue) are possible within 30 days of purchase, only for major defects or non-conformities (minor defects are not covered). See the definition of a major defect below.

item7.title: EXCHANGES
item7.description: The fastest way to get the item you want is to return the one you have and, once the return is accepted, place a new separate order for the new item. Return shipping costs remain your responsibility. We cannot guarantee receipt of your returned parcel, so we recommend using a tracked, insured shipping method.

item8.title: DAMAGE AND ISSUES FOUND
item8.description: Due to the nature of the products, slight variations in appearance (label, packaging) may occur without affecting product quality. Major defects include: a package that is unsealed or damaged on arrival, an expired best-before date, or receiving a product different from the one ordered. In this last case, contact us immediately for an exchange or refund.

item9.title: EXCEPTIONS / NON-REFUNDABLE ITEMS
item9.description: Some products cannot be returned, in particular products whose packaging has been opened (for hygiene and health safety reasons), sale items, or gift cards. For any question about a specific product, feel free to contact us.

item10.title: HOW DO I START A RETURN?
item10.description: Go to "My Orders", select the relevant item, and follow the steps in the return form. A prepaid label will be emailed to you within 24 hours.

item11.title: HOW DO I CHOOSE MY FORMAT / DOSAGE?
item11.description: Each product page shows the recommended dosage and detailed nutritional information. If you're unsure which dosage suits your situation, we recommend consulting a healthcare professional.

item12.title: DOES THE PACKAGING MATCH THE PHOTOS?
item12.description: We adjust our photos to stay as close to reality as possible, but a slight difference may remain depending on your screen settings or a minor update to the supplier's packaging. Feel free to write to us for details on any product.

item13.title: WHAT PAYMENT METHODS DO YOU ACCEPT?
item13.description: We accept credit cards (Visa, Mastercard, Amex), PayPal, as well as installment payments depending on your cart amount.

item14.title: IS MY BANKING INFORMATION SECURE?
item14.description: Yes, all payments are processed by a PCI-DSS certified provider. We never store your banking details on our servers.

item15.title: HOW DO I RESET MY PASSWORD?
item15.description: From the login page, click "Forgot password" and follow the instructions sent by email to choose a new one.

item16.title: HOW DO I DELETE MY ACCOUNT?
item16.description: Send us a request from the Contact page with the email address linked to your account. Deletion takes effect within 48 hours in accordance with GDPR.

bottomBanner.title: Have another question?
bottomBanner.subtitle: Our customer service team is here to help.

zones.title: DELIVERY AREAS
zones.description: PrettyFull delivers throughout Abidjan (Cocody, Marcory, Yopougon, Plateau, Riviera and other districts) as well as to major inland cities of Côte d'Ivoire (Bouaké, Yamoussoukro, San-Pédro, Korhogo, Abengourou, among others). Regional delivery to certain WAEMU-zone countries (Senegal, Burkina Faso, Mali, Togo, Benin) is also available on request; contact our customer service to check availability and fees for your destination.

delays.title: DELIVERY TIMES
delays.description: Orders are prepared within 24 to 48 business hours. Allow a further 24 to 72 hours for delivery in Abidjan, and 3 to 7 business days for other cities in Côte d'Ivoire. For regional deliveries (WAEMU zone), the timeframe is generally between 5 and 10 business days depending on the destination country and carrier used. These timeframes are indicative and may vary during peak periods (end-of-year holidays, sales) or for pre-order items.

fees.title: DELIVERY FEES
fees.description: Delivery fees are calculated based on geographic area and displayed before final order confirmation, directly on the payment page. Delivery is free in Abidjan above a minimum purchase amount shown on the site at checkout. For deliveries within the country and internationally, a flat fee applies depending on the destination city or country.

tracking.title: ORDER TRACKING
tracking.description: As soon as your parcel is picked up by our delivery agent or partner carrier, you receive a notification (SMS, WhatsApp or email) with the delivery agent's contact details or a tracking link depending on the delivery method chosen. You can also track your order status at any time from the "My Orders" section of your account.

damagedParcel.title: DAMAGED, INCOMPLETE OR INCORRECT PARCEL
damagedParcel.description: We recommend checking your parcel as soon as you receive it, if possible in front of the delivery agent. If an item arrives damaged, incomplete, or doesn't match your order, contact our customer service within 48 hours of receipt, attaching photos of the product and packaging. After review, we proceed with an exchange, repair or refund, at no extra cost to you.

returnWindow.title: RETURN AND EXCHANGE WINDOW
returnWindow.description: You have 14 days from receipt of your order to request a return or exchange. After this period, no request can be accepted, except in the case of a manufacturing defect discovered later. To start a return, contact our customer service via the Contact page or from your "My Orders" area, specifying the reason for your request.

returnConditions.title: PRODUCT RETURN CONDITIONS
returnConditions.description: To be accepted, a returned product must be in its original packaging, sealed and unopened, with all its labels and inserts. For hygiene and health safety reasons, any product whose packaging has been opened, unsealed, or whose protective film has been removed cannot be accepted back, unless a genuine manufacturing defect is found upon opening.

refund.title: REFUND TERMS
refund.description: Once the returned item is received and inspected by our team, you receive confirmation of the return's acceptance or refusal. If accepted, the refund is issued within 5 to 10 business days to the same payment method used for the purchase (Mobile Money, credit card) or as store credit for a future order, according to your preference. Original delivery fees are only refunded in case of a defect or error attributable to PrettyFull.

nonReturnable.title: NON-RETURNABLE PRODUCTS
nonReturnable.description: For hygiene and health safety reasons, any dietary supplement, vitamin, or wellness product whose packaging has been opened cannot be returned or exchanged, unless a genuine manufacturing defect is found. The same applies to promotional items marked as "final sale" and gift cards. These exclusions are indicated on the product page where applicable.

exchange.title: FORMAT OR FLAVOR EXCHANGE
exchange.description: If the product received doesn't suit you in format or flavor and its packaging remains sealed, an exchange is possible within the same timeframe and conditions as a standard return, subject to availability of the replacement product. If the desired product is no longer available, we offer a refund or store credit. Return shipping costs for the new product are covered by us when the exchange results from our error, and remain the Customer's responsibility in other cases.

purpose.title: 1. PURPOSE
purpose.description: These Terms and Conditions of Sale ("Terms") govern all sales of vitamins, dietary supplements and wellness products made on the PrettyFull site by any individual or entity (the "Customer") wishing to make a purchase through our online shop. Placing an order on the site implies full and unreserved acceptance of these Terms. PrettyFull reserves the right to modify these Terms at any time; the version applicable is the one in effect on the day of the order.

products.title: 2. PRODUCTS AND AVAILABILITY
products.description: Products offered for sale are those listed on the site on the day of consultation, within the limits of available stock. Each product is presented with a description, photographs, and available nutritional information, intended to inform the Customer as accurately as possible. If a product becomes unavailable after ordering, the Customer will be informed as soon as possible and may choose a full refund, a replacement product, or to wait for restocking.

prices.title: 3. PRICES AND CURRENCY
prices.description: All prices displayed on the site are expressed in CFA Francs (FCFA / XOF), all taxes included, excluding delivery fees which are specified before final order confirmation. PrettyFull reserves the right to change its prices at any time, it being understood that the price applicable to an order is the one in effect at the time the Customer confirms it.

payment.title: 4. PAYMENT METHODS
payment.description: Orders can be paid via Mobile Money (Wave, Orange Money, MTN Money, Moov Money), by credit card (Visa, Mastercard) through our secure payment provider, or by cash on delivery depending on the delivery area and terms specified at checkout. The order is only finally confirmed after payment confirmation or, for cash on delivery, after phone confirmation by our team.

orderValidation.title: 5. ORDER CONFIRMATION
orderValidation.description: Every order placed on the site is presented as a summary (products, formats, flavors, prices, delivery address) that the Customer must check before confirming. Once the order is confirmed, a summary email and/or message is sent to the Customer. PrettyFull reserves the right to cancel or refuse any order from a Customer with whom there is a dispute regarding payment of a previous order, or in case of reasonable doubt about the order's validity.

delivery.title: 6. DELIVERY
delivery.description: PrettyFull delivers to Abidjan and major cities in Côte d'Ivoire, as well as, in some cases, certain WAEMU-zone countries. Delivery times and fees applicable to each order are communicated before payment confirmation and detailed on our "Shipping and Returns" page. The Customer agrees to provide an accurate delivery address and a reachable phone number; PrettyFull cannot be held responsible for a delay or non-delivery resulting from an incorrect address provided by the Customer.

withdrawal.title: 7. RIGHT OF WITHDRAWAL
withdrawal.description: Except for personalized products, pre-ordered products, or products whose packaging has been opened for hygiene and health safety reasons, the Customer has a period to change their mind and request a return or exchange, under the conditions and timeframes specified in our Shipping and Returns policy. The product must then be returned in its original condition, packaging sealed and unopened, with its labels.

returns.title: 8. RETURNS, EXCHANGES AND REFUNDS
returns.description: The precise terms for returns, exchanges and refunds (timeframes, excluded items, procedure and possible fees) are detailed on our dedicated "Shipping and Returns" page, which forms an integral part of these Terms. Every refund is issued to the same payment method used for the purchase, unless otherwise agreed with the Customer.

warranty.title: 9. WARRANTY AND CONFORMITY
warranty.description: PrettyFull commits to delivering products that conform to their description and are free of manufacturing defects. If a product has a major defect (packaging damaged or unsealed on delivery, expired product, wrong item shipped) found upon receipt, the Customer must report it to our customer service as soon as possible, with supporting photographs, so that a solution (exchange, refund) can be offered at no extra cost to the Customer.

personalData.title: 10. PERSONAL DATA
personalData.description: Personal information collected when ordering (identity, contact details, delivery address, purchase history) is used solely for processing and tracking orders as well as, with the Customer's consent, for marketing communications. This data is neither sold nor transferred to third parties not involved in fulfilling the order (carrier, payment provider). In accordance with applicable data protection regulations, the Customer has the right to access, rectify and delete their data, which they may exercise by contacting us via the site's Contact page.

intellectualProperty.title: 11. INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY
intellectualProperty.description: All elements of the PrettyFull site (logo, visual identity, product photographs, text, layout) are protected by intellectual property law and remain the exclusive property of PrettyFull. Any reproduction, representation or use, in whole or in part, of these elements without prior written authorization is strictly prohibited.

liability.title: 12. LIABILITY
liability.description: PrettyFull cannot be held liable for damages resulting from use of the site not in accordance with its intended purpose, fraudulent intrusion, a case of force majeure, or any malfunction of the internet network or Mobile Money payment operators beyond its control. Product photographs are as accurate as possible but cannot guarantee a perfect match with the product received (packaging, color), due to display variations between screens.

healthWarnings.title: 13. WARNINGS AND HEALTH INFORMATION
healthWarnings.description: Dietary supplements are not a substitute for a varied and balanced diet or a healthy lifestyle, and should not be used as such. Follow the daily dose indicated on the product label; do not exceed the recommended dose without medical advice. Keep out of reach of young children. It is advisable to seek the advice of a healthcare professional before use, especially in case of pregnancy, breastfeeding, ongoing medical treatment, or a specific condition. In case of an adverse reaction, stop using the product and consult a healthcare professional.

jurisdiction.title: 14. GOVERNING LAW AND DISPUTES
jurisdiction.description: These Terms and Conditions of Sale are governed by Ivorian law. In the event of a dispute regarding the interpretation or performance of an order, the Customer is invited to first contact our customer service to seek an amicable solution. Failing an amicable agreement, the competent courts of Côte d'Ivoire shall have sole jurisdiction over the dispute.
